speaker: caller
text: Hello, this is the card security team from your bank. We want to check one transaction on your credit card.

speaker: caller
text: There was a purchase of one hundred and twenty dollars at an online electronics store this morning. Was that you?

speaker: receiver
text: No, I didn't buy anything today.

speaker: caller
text: Thank you. We have blocked the card to keep your account safe, and the charge will be reversed.

speaker: receiver
text: Okay. Do I need to do anything?

speaker: caller
text: A replacement card will be mailed to your registered address in five working days.

speaker: caller
text: We will never ask for your PIN or a one-time password. If you're unsure, call us back on the number on the back of your card.

speaker: receiver
text: I will. Thanks for letting me know.
